newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX name network chairman.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX name network chairman.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp. and NYNEX Corp. said Thursday that Lawrence Babbio would be the president and chief executive of the network group after the two companies complete their merger.
Babbio, a Bell Atlantic vice chairman, will take the position originally slated for Richard Jalkut of NYNEX, who announced this week plans to retire, the companies said.
Babbio also will serve as chairman of the global wireless group, the companies said.

The new Bell Atlantic will have five operating groups reporting to the chairman: the telecommunications group, led by Jim Cullen; the network group, led by Babbio; the global wireless group, also led by Babbio; the information services group, led by Mat Stover; and the international telecommunications group, with a president still to be named.
All business development and finance activities will be consolidated under Fred Salerno, who also will report to the chairman's office, the companies said.
